overview: Elitz 2 is a twin-tower mixed-use project, distinct from Elitz and Elitz 3. Danube lists 801 apartments; that headline is not available resale inventory.
Some plans include private pools, office spaces or a maid’s room. These are layout-specific features and should be checked against the exact unit and final specification.
research.locationNote: Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai. Indicative marketing access routes are not measured walking distances or guaranteed journey times.
research.priceNote: Property Finder lists AED 650,000 as a launch reference. The developer shows SOLD OUT; neither establishes today’s selected-unit price or owner resale availability.
research.paymentNote: Danube displays 30/70 without a dated milestone schedule and retains a 1%-monthly section. Property Finder lists 10% booking, 55% construction and 35% on handover; Tanami describes a historical 65/35 plan with 35% after handover. Those timings differ materially. Confirm the exact signed offer rather than combining them.
research.handoverNote: The developer hero displays December 2027 while its FAQ still says Q3 2026. Property Finder shows Q4/October 2026 and inconsistent older narrative. A current contractual completion date and actual handover have not been verified.

unresolved: The developer’s completion and payment headline conflict with older sections and portal references; request a dated unit-specific schedule and delivery evidence.
Selected ranges are from the branded Tower A/B pack, not a complete measured inventory. Furniture, parking allocation, title conditions, fees and annual service/cooling charges remain unverified.
Facilities and private pools depend on the selected layout and contract. No actual occupancy, current inventory, return guarantee or operating amenity claim is made.
